versions.changelog:
- Bumped version to 1.0.2 with no file changes detected.
- No functional or documentation updates in this release.

- Updated status polling endpoint in usage instructions from /api/status/<prompt_id> to /api/status-claw/<prompt_id>
- Clarified recommended workflow and endpoint usage in documentation
- Incremented version to 1.0.1 for documentation and instruction fixes
- No changes to functionality or code detected

- Initial release of ClawImage Free: AI-powered portrait and image generation with no authentication required.
- Generate portraits representing 140+ nationalities, 8 styles, 24 moods, and diverse customization options using a fast (3-5 second) curl-based API.
- Designed for professional headshots, character design, fashion visualization, creative projects, and diverse representation.
- Built-in content safety filters with clear usage policies; refuses requests for minors, nudity, violence, hate speech, and illegal content.
- Simple API workflow: submit request, poll status, and download images—all with curl, no registration needed.
